_comment: Ground truth for testbed/vulnapp.mjs. `detect` = a bug the testbed plants that the engine must report; `clean` = a control that must never be reported. Run `node run.mjs --check`. Matched case-insensitively against every finding name the engine produced (scored + redteam + api + sast + cookie + header + path).

detect.bug: SQL injection reachable at the root ?id= parameter
reflected XSS at the root ?q= parameter
command injection at the root ?ping= parameter
SSRF via the root ?url= parameter
blind SSRF proven by a callback to the local OOB collaborator
XXE proven by the app resolving an external entity to the collaborator
SSTI via the root ?name= parameter
NoSQL operator auth bypass at /login
Origin reflection with credentials on /
redirect target taken from the ?next= parameter
/api/checkout bills the client-supplied unit price
/api/webhooks/stripe verifies signatures only for usd
the guestbook form stores and re-renders input unescaped
the JSON echo deep-merges __proto__ and reads 'json spaces' unguarded

detect.match: Active CRLF / HTTP Response Header Injection
detect.bug: CRLF in ?lang= splits the response header block (raw-socket proxy on PORT+1)
X-Forwarded-Host trusted for canonical links on /
introspection enabled on /graphql

detect.match: Cookie .sid. is set without the HttpOnly
detect.bug: session cookie without HttpOnly on /
no CSP header
no anti-clickjacking header
no nosniff header
.env served with secrets
.git/config served
/app.js.map is served next to a sourceMappingURL reference
a live-looking Stripe key in the page markup

detect.match: Exposed Credential Signature \(AWS Access Key ID\)
detect.bug: a non-placeholder AWS key id in the page markup
an 8-char reset token in a fuzzed JSON response
lodash 4.17.15 named in a loaded script URL
the third target's root is an auto-generated index
X-Powered-By names Express and its version
SQLi/XSS on the crawled /vuln/search parameter
LFI on the crawled /vuln/include parameter
path traversal on the crawled /vuln/file parameter

clean.bug: no finding may reference a hardened /safe/* control route (escaped input, allow-listed redirects, parameterised query)
